name: file-source-variants
notes: Example: one plugin (a placeholder, My Reverb.vst3) on a track that plays a recording of your own, sources/voice.wav next to this file (not shipped). verb: five settings of the plugin, each rendered and compared with the dry render; the residual is measured and written down, not judged, and every render is kept for listening. verb-repeat: the same project rendered twice; whether the plugin is deterministic is reported, and both renders are kept when they differ. verb and verb-repeat have notSilent: two silent renders would be identical too. verb-tail: three seconds rendered past the end of the recording, so the reverb tail is in the file; judged on its own (not silent). The parameter names Size and Tone are placeholders: run.ps1 -List lists the real ones. See docs/CONFIG.md.
